svg.title: Environment sets the physiological constraints.
svg.desc: Soil, water transport and leaf heat balance reshape the space of viable photosynthetic strategies.
svg.text: Soil, water transport and leaf heat balance reshape the space of viable photosynthetic strategies.
From physiological feasibility to evolutionary accessibility
Assimilation • sensitivity & uncertainty • replicated evolutionary histories • persistence of intermediates
Conceptual research framework • coupled processes, not a species reconstruction or a guaranteed route to C4.
